name: Thief tools and tricks
notes: Thief verbs (ADR-0004: tools on the belt grant their verb while carried; tricks are learned from contacts). Seeded with the thief's signatures from class data (mw-e19.4): Lockpicks, granted by the lockpicks item in the starting kit, and Pickpocket, a starting trick.

capabilities.name: Pick Locks
capabilities.description: Open a lock with picks instead of a key (ADR-0004 lock chain, step 1). Held while lockpicks are carried. A thief signature: never shared.

capabilities.name: Pickpocket
capabilities.description: Lift an item or coin from an unaware pocket (ADR-0004 pocket chain, step 1). A thief signature: never shared.
